tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground. Holds ink, ink-secondary and ink-tertiary text and every control; the white of white-on-grey layouts.

tokens.name: bg-subtle
tokens.usage: Grey sections, tile cards, filter pills, the table tray and chips. Ink, ink-secondary and ink-tertiary all read on it.

tokens.name: bg-muted
tokens.usage: Hover fills, secondary pills, progress tracks, selected rows. Ink, ink-secondary and ink-tertiary read on it.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: White cards laid on grey sections, menus, popovers, the table header row. In the dark theme one step lighter than bg.

tokens.name: bg-inverse
tokens.usage: Primary pill buttons, the selected tab, the cookie pill, dark CTA bands. Holds ink-inverse and ink-inverse-secondary text.

tokens.name: bg-glass
tokens.usage: Translucent bars and cards over imagery or haze, always with backdrop blur. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: bg-scrim
tokens.usage: Dimmer behind modals and drawers. Never carries text.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, bg-subtle, bg-muted, bg-raised and the aura fields. Headlines, numerals, selected states.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, units next to numerals; reads on bg, bg-subtle, bg-muted, bg-raised and the aura fields.

tokens.name: ink-tertiary
tokens.usage: Captions, inactive list items, placeholder text; reads on bg, bg-subtle, bg-muted and bg-raised at 4.5:1 or more.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and icons only. Exempt from contrast by definition; never use for content that must be read.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on bg-inverse (black pill buttons, selected tabs, dark bands).

tokens.name: ink-inverse-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text on bg-inverse.

tokens.name: line-hairline
tokens.usage: Row dividers and header underlines. Decorative: never the only cue that separates two things.

tokens.name: line-default
tokens.usage: Card and window outlines (1px). Decorative; contents stay legible without it.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, checkboxes, radios, dashed add-filter pills; at least 3:1 against bg, bg-subtle and bg-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: line-inverse
tokens.usage: Dividers inside bg-inverse surfaces.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Sber brand green, the single hue of the system: filled app-icon, switch and checkbox fills, active progress, selected bars, the first chart series. Fills hold on-accent text (not white: white is only 3.4:1 on it); as a thin graphic it is 3:1 or more on bg, bg-subtle and bg-raised.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of accent fills: a step lighter, so on-accent text keeps 4.5:1.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Solid green tint behind accent-ink: filter-pill value, selected nav item, soft badge, banner. For layers over imagery use the accent-a* alpha shades instead.

tokens.name: accent-a08
tokens.usage: Faintest wash: hover on list rows and cards, the selected row, the hatch gap in progress.

tokens.name: accent-a16
tokens.usage: Quiet tint: soft badge and chip backgrounds, selected nav item over imagery, icon-button resting state.

tokens.name: accent-a24
tokens.usage: Medium tint: pressed state, drop-zone on drag-over, the halo around an active dot.

tokens.name: accent-a40
tokens.usage: Strong tint: dividers and outlines on green surfaces, disabled accent fill, the track of a green meter.

tokens.name: accent-a64
tokens.usage: Heavy tint: secondary series, area gradient start, the glow behind a featured block. Text over it is ink.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Green as text or small icon on bg, bg-subtle, bg-muted and accent-soft (links, selected labels). Darker than the brand green in the light theme so it clears 4.5:1.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill: near-black green, 5.4:1 on the brand green; never plain white.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a solid 2px ring with 2px offset; at least 3:1 on bg, bg-subtle, bg-muted and bg-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive status text and icons (Норма/OK, growth delta) on bg, bg-subtle and success-soft. Always paired with a word or arrow.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the ok status pill and success alerts.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Caution text and icons on bg and warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of draft and caution pills and alerts.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error and alert text, icons and destructive fills on bg and danger-soft; fills hold on-danger text.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the alert status pill and error alerts.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral-informational text and icons (Pending pill, info alert) on bg and info-soft.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the pending status pill and info alerts.

tokens.name: toast-ok
tokens.usage: Success icon inside a toast. Toasts sit on bg-inverse, so this is the opposite theme's success.

tokens.name: toast-bad
tokens.usage: Error icon inside a toast, on bg-inverse.

tokens.name: white-fixed
tokens.usage: White that never flips: text and controls over video and photography.

tokens.name: aura-green
tokens.usage: Pale Sber-green field: media tiles, avatars, stages and the featured card. Holds ink, ink-secondary and ink-tertiary.

tokens.name: aura-mint
tokens.usage: Mint field for media tiles, avatars and stages.

tokens.name: aura-peach
tokens.usage: Peach field for media tiles, avatars and stages.

tokens.name: aura-lilac
tokens.usage: Lilac field for media tiles, avatars and stages.

tokens.name: aura-sand
tokens.usage: Sand field for media tiles, avatars and stages; the neutral warm option.

tokens.name: haze-1
tokens.usage: Strong end of the haze gradient in Sber green (bottom-right of heroes, top-right of screen headers).

tokens.name: haze-2
tokens.usage: Soft end of the haze gradient, a cool teal-white (opposite corner), so the haze runs green into teal like the brand gradient. Text over haze is ink or ink-secondary.

tokens.name: haze-mint
tokens.usage: Strong end of the mint haze; text over it is ink.

tokens.name: haze-peach
tokens.usage: Strong end of the peach haze.

tokens.name: haze-lilac
tokens.usage: Strong end of the lilac haze.

tokens.name: video-ground
tokens.usage: Fixed dark ground of video frames in both themes; text over it is white-fixed.

tokens.name: video-glow-1
tokens.usage: Brand-green light bleeding into video frames and generated media placeholders.

tokens.name: video-glow-2
tokens.usage: Second glow of video frames, teal; never a purple pairing.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: First data series and the highlighted bar: Sber green. 3:1 or more on bg, bg-subtle and bg-raised.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Second series: deep teal, the cool end of the Sber gradient. 3:1 or more on the page grounds.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Third series.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Fourth series (slate-lavender, as in line charts of the reference).

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Fifth series.

tokens.name: chart-6
tokens.usage: Sixth series and neutral comparison line.

tokens.name: chart-track
tokens.usage: Empty track behind bar and progress fills.

tokens.name: chart-soft
tokens.usage: Soft area fill under a line and non-highlighted bars.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Dashed grid lines and axes in line charts.

groups.name: Display and headings
groups.note: Tight negative tracking from 28px up, medium weight; screen titles and numerals go light (300).

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: Hero headline, one per page, 16 characters per line at most.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Large section titles and the hero of inner pages.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Call-to-action titles.

styles.name: heading-xl
styles.usage: Section titles.

styles.name: heading-lg
styles.usage: Titles of application screens: light weight, large and airy.

styles.name: heading-md
styles.usage: Card titles, big list options.

styles.name: heading-sm
styles.usage: Mega-menu links.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Feature titles, modal titles.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Один язык, чтобы собрать любой интерфейс.
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a headline, 52 characters per line at most.

groups.name: Text and numerals
groups.note: Body is 16px; interface text 15px; captions 14px. No size below 14px except mono tags.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Large body text in articles and CTA text.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default reading text.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Controls, table cells, list rows, chip labels.

styles.name: ui-strong
styles.usage: Button labels and active tab labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata, hints, helper text, table headers.

styles.name: numeral-xl
styles.usage: Giant light numerals with a grey unit (Mediora-style metric).

styles.name: numeral-lg
styles.usage: Metric values in cards.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Dashboard stat values, tabular figures.

groups.name: Mono
groups.note: Only for labels, tags and code.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels and mono badges.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks and keyboard hints.

styles.name: mono-sm
styles.usage: Mono tags such as BETA, NEW, version.

spacing.note: 4px base with a 12/16/24/32/48 rhythm; sections breathe at 112px.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tight inline spacing.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside controls and between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between related rows; pill horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Standard gutter between cards; compact card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Phone screen side padding, option card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding (md), page gutter on small screens.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Large pill horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large card padding, screen header padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Stage top padding; gap between title and content.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Frame and haze padding; extra-large card padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Gap between content blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Hero vertical padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Call-to-action band padding; big separators.

tokens.name: section-y-sm
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a compact section.

tokens.name: section-y-md
tokens.usage: Default vertical padding of a page section; air is the main ornament.

tokens.name: section-y-lg
tokens.usage: Vertical padding around a hero or a closing call to action.

radius.note: Generous: 16 for chips, 24 for cards, 48 for frames and windows; everything interactive and every label is a pill.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Kbd keys, tiny tags, tooltip corners.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small controls, code blocks inline, table cells highlight.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, menus, small buttons in rounded shape.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Chips, menu panels, table header row, prompt cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards, table tray, media tiles, modals.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Large cards, screen headers, video frames.

tokens.name: radius-3xl
tokens.usage: Frames, haze blocks, stages, app windows and CTA bands: the signature very large radius.

tokens.name: radius-device
tokens.usage: Top corners of an edgeless phone screen.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, filter pills, status pills, badges, nav tabs, avatars.

shadow.note: Shadows are rare and soft. Separation comes from tone (white on grey) and air.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Hairline lift of a hovered row or chip.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Small raised controls.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Hovered interactive card, menus and tooltips.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: App windows, drawers, floating phone screens.

tokens.name: shadow-xl
tokens.usage: Modals and the cookie pill. Shadows stay rare: separation is done by tone and air.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Compact buttons, nav links, filter value pill, small icon buttons.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default button, chip, input row, filter pill.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary call-to-action button, large inputs.

tokens.name: control-xl
tokens.usage: Hero button, hero chips, big search row.

duration.note: Motion is quick and quiet: 200ms for state changes.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Press feedback, small transforms.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Colour, background and border transitions (the standard 0.2s).

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Media zoom, accordion, menu entry.

tokens.name: duration-slower
tokens.usage: Hero entrances, page transitions.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Default easing for UI state changes.

tokens.name: ease-emphasized
tokens.usage: Entrances and large moves: quick start, long soft landing.

tokens.name: blur-sm
tokens.usage: Light frosted surfaces.

tokens.name: blur-md
tokens.usage: Sticky nav and glass buttons.

tokens.name: blur-lg
tokens.usage: Glass cards over haze and media.

tokens.name: z-nav
tokens.usage: Sticky navigation.

tokens.name: z-dropdown
tokens.usage: Menus and mega menu.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Modals and drawers.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts and the cookie pill.

tokens.name: z-tooltip
tokens.usage: Tooltips.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Outlines, dividers.

tokens.name: stroke-regular
tokens.usage: Icons.

tokens.name: stroke-thick
tokens.usage: Focus ring, selected card outline.

tokens.name: container-text
tokens.usage: Reading column.

tokens.usage: Full page grid including nav.
